research_topic: NC Medicaid / NCTracks enrollment pathway and taxonomy code for staff-secure group home
verdict: SOP Manual v2.24's designation of NCTracks enrollment + Provider Type 2 NPI + taxonomy 320800000X + CCP 8D-2 (Residential Treatment Services) is CORRECT.

nctracks_enrollment_pathway.medicaid_bh_taxonomy_guidance: https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/ — Providers must select a NC Medicaid accepted taxonomy that most closely matches their provider type, classification, or specialization.
nctracks_enrollment_pathway.effective_date_of_taxonomy_requirement: March 10, 2022 (Taxonomy Enrollment Requirement Reminders for Claims)
nctracks_enrollment_pathway.enrollment_required_for: Behavioral health providers serving NC Medicaid members (including Tailored Plan members).

provider_type_for_staff_secure_rtf.provider_type_designation: Provider Type 2 — NPI (National Provider Identifier) for facilities

taxonomy_code_320800000X.official_nucc_label: Community Based Residential Treatment Facility, Mental Illness
taxonomy_code_320800000X.alternate_label: Mental Illness Community Based Residential Treatment Facility
taxonomy_code_320800000X.alliance_health_acceptance: Confirmed — Alliance Health Standard Rate Schedule lists 320800000X under 'General Behavioral Health Services' for Community Based Residential Treatment Facility; Mental Illness.

related_taxonomy_codes_for_reference.320800000X: Community Based Residential Treatment Facility, Mental Illness — USE FOR .1700 staff-secure RTF
related_taxonomy_codes_for_reference.320900000X: Community Based Residential Treatment Facility, Mental Retardation (I/DD)
related_taxonomy_codes_for_reference.322000000X: Residential Treatment Facility, Substance Abuse Treatment
related_taxonomy_codes_for_reference.323P00000X: Psychiatric Residential Treatment Facility (PRTF) for 8D-1 billing — verify with NCTracks

important_clarification_on_taxonomy_3208.actual_nucc_label: Community Based Residential Treatment Facility, Mental Illness
important_clarification_on_taxonomy_3208.is_there_a_children_specific_taxonomy: NO — NUCC does not maintain a separate taxonomy code for 'Residential Treatment Facility, Children' under mental illness. 320800000X is the broad code for ALL community-based residential mental illness treatment facilities, both adult and child/adolescent. SOP Manual's parenthetical '(Residential Treatment Facility, Children)' is a description, not the official NUCC taxonomy label.
important_clarification_on_taxonomy_3208.compliance_status: COMPLIANT — 320800000X is the correct taxonomy code for both adult and child/adolescent community-based residential mental illness treatment. NCTracks enrollment using 320800000X is appropriate for Well Spring's .1700 staff-secure facility.

medicaid_clinical_coverage_policy_8d_2.applicability: Covers NC Medicaid-funded residential treatment services for children/adolescents (Level II, Level III, Level IV intensity) in non-PRTF community-based residential facilities.

policy_8d_series_for_reference.8D-1: Psychiatric Residential Treatment Facilities for Children under the Age of 21 (PRTF) — applies to .1900 series facilities
policy_8d_series_for_reference.8D-2: Residential Treatment Services — applies to .1700 staff-secure RTF (Level II/III/IV)
policy_8d_series_for_reference.8D-3: Clinically Managed Low-Intensity Residential Treatment Services
policy_8d_series_for_reference.8D-4: Clinically Managed Population Clinical Specific High-Intensity Residential Program

medicaid_clinical_coverage_policy_8d_2.level_3_designation: Level III = 'Residential Treatment High' intensity per CCP 8D-2 (corresponds to .1700 staff-secure facility classification). The SOP Manual's 'Level III (Residential Treatment High)' designation is consistent with NC Medicaid's level-of-care framework.
medicaid_clinical_coverage_policy_8d_2.asam_alignment_note: Note: ASAM levels (e.g., 3.5 Clinically Managed High-Intensity Residential Services) are separate from NC Medicaid's Level II/III/IV designation but may be used for clinical necessity determination.

enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_1: Obtain NPI Type 2 (Organization) from NPPES — https://nppes.cms.hhs.gov
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_2: Obtain NC DHSR Mental Health Licensure (10A NCAC 27G .1700 series) — prerequisite for Medicaid enrollment
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_3: Obtain letter of support from Alliance Health (per 10A NCAC 27G .0406) for behavioral health facility licensure
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_4: Enroll in NCTracks as Provider Type 2 with taxonomy 320800000X — https://www.nctracks.com
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step 5: Credential with Alliance Health Tailored Plan (Tailored Plan Provider Network) — https://www.alliancehealthplan.org
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_6: Obtain CARF CYS accreditation (state requirement per 10A NCAC 70I if also licensed as Residential Child Care Facility; required by Alliance Health for many service lines)
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_7: NC-TOPPS (North Carolina Treatment Outcomes and Program Performance System) registration for outcome reporting — required for any NC Medicaid provider of substance use or mental health services.
enrollment_steps_for_well_spring.step_8: Execute service agreement / attestation with Alliance Health for residential treatment services under CCP 8D-2.

nc_topps.full_name: North Carolina Treatment Outcomes and Program Performance System
nc_topps.purpose: Mandatory outcomes reporting system for NC DHHS-funded mental health, substance use, and I/DD services providers.
nc_topps.operator: NC Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) — Division of Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities, and Substance Use Services (DMH/DD/SUS)
nc_topps.applicability: REQUIRED for all providers billing NC Medicaid for mental health or substance use services — includes staff-secure RTF providers.
nc_topps.user_note: SOP Manual user query mentions 'NC-TOPPS / NC Medicaid enrollment' — these are TWO separate but related requirements: NCTracks enrollment is for billing/provider registration; NC-TOPPS is for treatment outcomes reporting. Both apply to Well Spring.
